summary: Full backend + frontend E2E pass on Surgiassist CRM with owner/manager/BDM. Backend: 20/20 pytest pass (auth, 5-fail lockout on throwaway email -> 429, RBAC 403s for BDM, BDM scoping, overview, exact single-date filter, filters/pagination/search, CSV export, follow-ups buckets + per-BDM, notifications/reminders, lead PATCH/notes, CRM edits survive manual sync, allocation run assigns an unassigned lead, normalization preview/save, team CRUD + manager limits, audit). Frontend: login/error, live countdown ticks, sync-now toast (admins only), KPIs + date change, charts, leaderboard (admin only), leads filters/pagination/export download, drawer save/timeline/note/reminder -> bell -> done, follow-ups date/BDM pick/tabs/Done, normalization tester + save, team add/toggle/delete, audit entries, BDM redirects, mobile hamburger at 390px all work with zero console errors. Two real bugs found: allocation treatment-priority chips cannot be toggled with a real mouse click, and saving the lead drawer without changing stage silently overwrites the sheet sub_status.

critical.issue: Any request containing `stage` (the drawer ALWAYS sends stage) sets sub_status = stage.upper() even if stage did not change. Result: opening a lead and clicking Save overwrites the granular sheet status (e.g. 'FUND ISSUE' -> 'LOST', 'DNP1' -> 'NOT REACHABLE', 'CALL BACK' -> 'FOLLOW UP') and adds 'sub_status' to edited_fields so future syncs never refresh it. Reproduced as BDM muskaan on lead 1853944155608417 (Sabiha); tester restored it in DB afterwards.

minor.issue: Manual sync does not reset SYNC_STATE.next_sync_at, so the navbar countdown keeps counting the old auto schedule (an auto sync runs again within a few minutes of the manual one).

Rows without a numeric Lead ID get id = md5(name|phone|creation time) and duplicates get '-1','-2' suffixes by row order. If the sheet name/phone gets corrected or duplicate rows are reordered, CRM edits (stage/bdm/follow-up, activity) attach to the wrong lead or are dropped (delete_many on ids not seen), leaving orphaned activity/reminders.
Only regex-checks YYYY-MM-DD; '2026-13-45' is accepted and stored as follow_up_date.

Correct password on an inactive account counts as a failed attempt (can lock a deactivated user's email); response is the generic 401, fine. Auth uses Bearer token in localStorage, not httpOnly cookies (playbook item 2 not applicable by design); CORS '*' without credentials is consistent with that.

ui_bugs.issue: Chips do not toggle on a real mouse click (page.click and mouse.move+click both fail 7/7; only programmatic element.click() works). Captured events: pointerdown/mousedown land on the parent 'div.flex.flex-wrap', mouseup on the chip, so the browser dispatches click to the common ancestor and the button's onClick never runs. RCA: the TiltCard 3D rotateX/rotateY (useSpring on mousemove) plus `.chip:hover { transform: translateY(-1px) }` shifts the chip under the pointer between mousedown and mouseup. Fix: don't wrap interactive allocation cards in TiltCard (use plain glass div or intensity 0), and/or remove the chip hover transform, or handle toggle on onPointerDown.

integration_issues.issue: EditPanel always sends stage + follow_up_date even if they did not change, which triggers the sub_status overwrite described in backend critical issue. Send only changed fields.

design_issues.screen: Leads filters, Overview, Follow-ups, Lead drawer
issues: Uses native browser <input type=date> pickers and native <select> instead of shadcn Calendar/Popover and Select components; looks inconsistent with the glass theme
Page title truncates to 'Leads & P…' because sync pill + bell take the row; consider hiding the sync label or shortening the title on mobile

action_items: Fix allocation priority chips not toggling on real clicks (remove TiltCard tilt / chip hover transform on interactive cards)
PATCH /api/leads: only change sub_status (and log/add edited_fields) when stage actually differs from the stored stage; frontend drawer should send only changed fields
Reset SYNC_STATE.next_sync_at (or restart the loop timer) after a manual sync so the countdown restarts at 05:00
Use datetime.strptime validation in valid_date to reject impossible dates
Consider a more stable identity for rows without Lead ID so CRM edits are not lost/misattached when sheet rows change
Replace native date inputs/selects with shadcn Calendar/Select for design consistency
critical_code_review_comments: server.py update_lead: `changes['sub_status'] = changes['stage'].upper()` runs unconditionally when stage is present -> silent data overwrite + permanent sync lock of sub_status
run_sync deletes leads no longer in sheet but leaves their activity/reminders orphaned
Followups 'Done' always clears follow-up date (next_date '') with no UI to set the next date, although the API supports next_date
server.py is 648 lines - close to the 700 line limit; consider splitting routes into modules

The lead-mutation test picks a 'Follow Up' lead, edits it, syncs, unassigns + runs allocation with only one BDM active, then restores everything. Retest: allocation chips with real page.click (not JS click), and drawer Save-without-changes must not change sub_status/edited_fields (check a Lost lead with sub_status like 'FUND ISSUE').
rca of the issue: Chips: mousedown target = parent flex div, mouseup target = chip -> click goes to ancestor; caused by framer-motion tilt transform + hover translate moving the chip under the cursor. sub_status: update_lead derives sub_status from stage whenever stage is in the payload, and LeadDrawer always includes stage. Repro: login as muskaan, open any lead whose sheet status differs from its stage name (e.g. FUND ISSUE / Lost), click Save changes -> Sheet status shows LOST and edited_fields gains sub_status.
